- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-801 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The second-parent check in _is_must_contain_resolver_union_merge_false_positive accepts any second-parent line meeting the shape constraints, without tying it to the line the other side actually edited (e.g. captured `abc`, merged `aXbc`, unrelated line `aXc` passes).
  WHY: A resolver-inserted change can be classified as a valid union merge and skip the wave-dispatch fingerprint violation. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT because the captured line is still kept whole. Gemini, gpt-6-luna, qwen and minimax rated it MAJOR (minimax gave no severity label), so the highest is used.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: _matched_positions(literal, merged_line) is recomputed inside the inner other_lines loop although it is loop-invariant. Related performance notes: difflib runs on every longer line (nested SequenceMatcher cost), and a cheap pre-filter is suggested.
  WHY: The repeated difflib work adds cost on large files for each must_contain miss, with no correctness impact. Severity is NIT, with the hardening items scored at risk 1 to 3.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The verifier-side defense must fail closed for a list of rejection conditions (not pure re.escape, dropped or changed captured characters, extra inserted text, single parent, resolver before captured_at, working-tree mode, missing captured_at), and these should be documented.
  expected_change_site: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py — docstring of `_is_must_contain_resolver_union_merge_false_positive` (lines 707-726)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The docstring lists only the acceptance bullets and does not list the rejection conditions, which appear only in the code guards. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reported the opposite: they found the docstring and docs already cover the rejection cases.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:783-801 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The second-parent line is not tied to the line the other side edited (captured `abc`, merged `aXbc`, unrelated `aXc` passes). The reviewer judged it a heuristic limitation, not a defect, because the captured line is still kept whole and real lines are long.
  WHY: It only matters if the resolver inserts text that matches an unrelated second-parent line.
- HARDENING: skip a line first if the captured line is not a subsequence of it, using a linear scan (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:796-801 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The logic that identifies the corresponding line from the resolver's second parent is weak.
  WHY: It accepts the first line that satisfies the heuristic without verifying it corresponds to the same context, so it may pick an unrelated line.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The check iterates over every second-parent line and never requires other_line to be the line the second parent actually edited (the line at the same index as merged_line).
  WHY: Captured `abc`, merged `aXbc` and unrelated `aXc` pass all four shape constraints. A buggy resolver can bypass the wave-dispatch fingerprint gate.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:707-726 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: TASK_GAP. Requirement: the defense must fail closed in the listed rejection cases. Expected change site: the docstring of `_is_must_contain_resolver_union_merge_false_positive`. Evidence of absence: the docstring lists the acceptance bullets only, and the rejection conditions are implicit in the code guards.
  WHY: A reader cannot tell from the docstring alone which cases the function refuses.
- HARDENING: before `_only_inserts`, check the first and last characters of the literal. Keep only the other_line at the same index as merged_line (about 4-6 lines). It also fixes the correctness finding. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The second-parent check does not establish that the candidate line is the corresponding line changed by the other side (captured `abc`, merged `aXbc`, unrelated `aXc` passes).
  WHY: The helper returns the resolver SHA and _evaluate_fp_state marks the fingerprint satisfied, so the wave-dispatch gate proceeds despite the resolver's change.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The check accepts any second-parent line that satisfies the substring and coverage constraints without verifying it is the line corresponding to the captured line (captured `abc`, merged `aXbc`, unrelated `aXc` passes).
  WHY: The gate can skip a violation when the resolver added text that happens to appear in an unrelated line of the other parent.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:793-796 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_matched_positions(literal, merged_line)` is computed inside the inner other_lines loop although it is loop-invariant.
  WHY: Each must_contain miss repeats the same difflib computation unnecessarily on large files. Hoisting it removes the redundant work.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-character coverage rule still accepts an inserted run taken from any second-parent line (captured `abc`, merged `aXbc`, unrelated `aXc` passes). The "added nothing of its own" guarantee is weaker than the docstring claims.
  WHY: The gate can classify a resolver-composed line as a valid union. The reviewer rated it a NIT because the captured line is still kept whole, so silent reverts remain caught.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:789-799 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_matched_positions(literal, merged_line)` is rebuilt for every other_line although it is loop-invariant.
  WHY: Each must_contain miss pays 2N SequenceMatcher constructions instead of N+1, with no correctness impact.
- HARDENING: hoist `covered_literal = _matched_positions(literal, merged_line)` above the `for other_line in other_lines:` loop (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
